categories.reasoning: Consultations are recorded for six steps with named groups (con-staff-workshop, con-member-interviews, con-funder-interview, con-assembly, con-measurement-workshop, con-problem-tree-review). The least-heard group, tg-low-access-residents (act-residents), has no consultation record, and no absence is acknowledged. County and city officials, who are named as partners in oc-im-officials-engage, are also absent from consultations.

Every link in the document has a rationale (e.g. ln-cohorts-skills, ln-pooled-overhead). Precondition logic is stated with sufficiency text: grp-capable (all), grp-collab (at_least 2), grp-voice (all). Weakest links are flagged as hypothesis, not hidden: ln-collab-access, ln-collab-resvoice, ln-ties-positions. Lint TOC-LOG-001 and TOC-LOG-002 are GO.

Problem is traced from structural (cause-no-standing-voice) to underlying (cause-isolation, cause-funding-volatility) to immediate causes (cause-no-peer-exchange, cause-high-overhead). Outcomes address these via addressesCauses: oc-im-peer-network, oc-im-lower-overhead, oc-im-officials-engage, oc-lt-collective-voice. cause-funding-volatility is set aside with a reason (outOfScope). Lint TOC-CAU-001 GO.

Assumptions carry type, criticality and, for the critical and high ones, a test (asm-skills-applied, asm-members-deliver, asm-vendor-terms, asm-officials-receptive, asm-positions-hold). Context and partner assumptions are present (asm-peer-trust, asm-funders-fit, asm-officials-receptive). Risks mirror them with mitigations (rsk-time-burden, rsk-large-dominate, rsk-funder-shift). Lint TOC-ASM-002 warns that asm-officials-receptive and asm-positions-hold (both high) cite no evidence, which is noted under finding F4.

Every intervention has an owner (ownerActorId; lint TOC-INT-002 GO). Shared outcomes name deliverers (oc-resident-access deliveredBy; oc-im-officials-engage deliveredBy and responsibility partner). Partner stances are recorded on actors (e.g. act-county-office neutral, act-regional-funder supporter, act-vendors neutral).

Stated elements cite followable sources (e.g. oc-im-leaders-practice -> ev-peer-learning with a URL; oc-out-services -> ev-pooled-purchasing). Contrary evidence is kept (ev-collab-study, direction contradicts, which supports asm-peer-trust). Gaps are listed in the assessment (Gaps: outcomes with no indicator, indicators by data availability, assumptions needing testing). ev-funder-interview is restricted and is not penalized. Lint TOC-PRV-002 and TOC-PRV-003 are GO. The assessment states that 31 elements have no basis recorded (see F6).

Target groups are named (tg-small-members, tg-low-access-residents) and outcomes say what changes for them (oc-im-peer-network targets small members). But results are not broken down by target group: lint TOC-EQU-001 warns that oc-resident-access is for tg-low-access-residents with no disaggregated indicator. ind-residents-served breaks down by neighborhood and age group only. No indicator is disaggregated by tg-small-members either.
A pathway diagram (three logic models plus a one-page Mermaid diagram) and a plain-language narrative both exist. They agree on outcomes, links and grouping. A glossary of seven terms is present.

The three pathways are believable, and the early chain (cohorts to skills to practice) has realistic lags of P3M to P6M. Resident-level impact depends on a chain of roughly 2.5 years from the long-term outcomes (ln-capable-access, ln-collab-access P1Y; ln-voice-resvoice P2Y). Several links in that chain are hypothesis (ln-collab-access, ln-voice-resvoice, ln-collab-resvoice). The critical asm-members-deliver rests on one monitoring report (ev-county-services). The timing and scale of resident impact are stretched relative to the evidence.

Owners are named and the ceiling of accountability is declared as long_term with a rationale (ceilingOfAccountability). Resource limits are examined: about 8 staff, 90 staff minutes per week in measurementBudget, and rsk-staff-capacity with a mitigation. Officials' actions are attributed to partners, not to the network.

Most accountable outcomes are measured, and many indicators have baselines, targets, sources and frequencies (e.g. ind-hours-learning, ind-overhead-share). Four accountable outcomes have no indicator: oc-lt-capable-members, oc-im-peer-network, oc-st-calendar-use, oc-st-channel (narrative Gaps). Lint TOC-MEA-002 warns that ind-story-peer-help, ind-service-deals, ind-calendar-current and ind-briefings lack baseline, target and/or source. Lint TOC-MEA-001 is GO, but the stand-in mapping for those four outcomes is not visible in the document.

The document validates. Lint status is WARN overall, not GO, with four warning rules: TOC-ASM-002, TOC-EQU-001, TOC-MEA-002, TOC-MET-003. The narrative Gaps section partly explains the MEA-002 and EQU-001 findings, but TOC-ASM-002 and TOC-MET-003 (the retention roll-up cannot be computed without met-enrollments weights in pw-learning and pw-shared) are not explained anywhere in the document.

findings.title: Least-heard group not consulted and absence not acknowledged
findings.description: No consultation record includes tg-low-access-residents (act-residents) or the county and city officials who are partners in oc-im-officials-engage. The document does not acknowledge either absence.
findings.recommendation: Record a consultation with residents of low-access areas (or acknowledge the gap with a reason) and with county planning staff before approval.

findings.title: No indicator broken down by target group
findings.description: Lint TOC-EQU-001 (oc-resident-access, tg-low-access-residents). ind-residents-served breaks down by neighborhood and age group only. No indicator is disaggregated by tg-small-members, although oc-im-peer-network targets that group.
findings.recommendation: Add a disaggregation by tg-low-access-residents and tg-small-members to the indicators that measure their outcomes, or state why it is not feasible within the measurement budget.

findings.title: Accountable outcomes without indicators; indicators missing baselines
findings.description: oc-lt-capable-members, oc-im-peer-network, oc-st-calendar-use and oc-st-channel are within the ceiling of accountability and have no indicator (narrative Gaps). Lint TOC-MEA-002 flags ind-story-peer-help, ind-service-deals, ind-calendar-current and ind-briefings for missing baseline, target, source or frequency.
findings.recommendation: Add an indicator for each of the four outcomes, or record the stand-in, and complete the four indicators' baselines, targets and sources.

findings.title: High-criticality assumptions cite no evidence
findings.description: Lint TOC-ASM-002: asm-officials-receptive and asm-positions-hold are high criticality and cite no evidence. asm-positions-hold is untested (plausibility low). asm-officials-receptive is at_risk.
findings.recommendation: Cite the evidence behind both assumptions, or mark them as hypotheses and prioritise their tests before the civic pathway is approved.

findings.title: Resident-level impact timing stretched
findings.description: The chain from long-term outcomes to resident impact (ln-capable-access, ln-collab-access, ln-voice-resvoice) runs on P1Y and P2Y lags within a 2026-2028 horizon. Its weakest links are hypothesis, and asm-members-deliver rests on one monitoring report.
findings.recommendation: Make the resident-level claim explicitly a contribution over a longer horizon, or add a check point that would show whether the chain is moving.

findings.title: Many elements have no recorded basis
findings.description: The assessment states that 31 of 121 elements have no basis recorded, so their provenance cannot be checked.
findings.recommendation: Record a basis (stated, inferred, hypothesis or confirmed) for each element that is asserted to the organization.

findings.title: Lint warning TOC-MET-003 not explained
findings.description: met-retention-rate is measured in pw-learning and pw-shared but not met-enrollments, so the enrollment-weighted roll-up cannot be computed. The document does not explain this.
findings.recommendation: Add met-enrollments to the affected pathways' measurement, or document why the roll-up is not reported.

decision.rationale: Seven of twelve categories pass, but four required categories (process, plausible, testable, structural_integrity) are partial. No critical or high findings; four medium findings exceed the rubric's medium threshold of 3, so the theory needs fixes before approval.
